description: Get metadata for one Pipedrive file by id (name, size, mime type, linked deal/person/org). Never returns the bytes inline; with download=true it also returns download_url, a link valid for 1 hour to fetch the file itself (e.g. with curl in the runner, max 50 MB).

download.description: Also return download_url (1 hour) for the file content

file_id.description: ID of the file to read

name: get_pipedrive_file
